The real story: the AVN EXIT call is now unexecuted for its 4th consecutive review since Aug 25, and Sep 2 earnings — the event the exit was meant to get ahead of — is now just 2 trading days away (Tue Sep 1 is the last full session before the print). The Aug 25 EXIT call is now unexecuted through 4 reviews with the full 24,500 shares still in holdings, and the earnings print it was meant to pre-empt is 2 sessions away. EFERT — no news beyond what's already on file (H1 revenue −12%, profit −16% YoY, Rs 3.75/share H1 dividends paid, urea glut with management holding the Rs 150/bag premium, banking on H2 seasonal demand); stays on WATCH into Q3. DATA QUALITY: stock prices refreshed normally this session (last commit 10:37 PKT) — no repeat of Friday's feed outage. Fund NAVs (funds_updated: Aug 13) are now 18 days stale — the MUFAP scraper issue is still unresolved and needs a real fix.
